The question asks: How many sisters does Sally (a girl with 3 brothers) has, given that each of her brothers has 2 sisters.

- Each of her 3 brothers has 2 sisters.
- The phrase "each brother has 2 sisters" means the brothers share the same set of sisters — the family's girls.
